name: incubator-gaps2-interior-dusk-empty
refs: The painting to edit: keep everything identical except the one change described.
prompt: Edit the reference painting. The same picture with the pod removed and the moss-and-soil bed repainted where it stood, to match the moss around it, in the same painted hand, with no hole, ring or shadow left behind; the roof lamp's warm pool falls on the empty moss. The mint seal ring, the dusk light, the dark base bar and the camera stay identical. No pod, no egg, no shell, no creature, no text.
